  ELSE

  END IF
  IF (X > 50) THEN

  END IF
  CLAMP_SCORE = CLAMP_SCORE
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION IS_PASSING(X)
  IF (CLAMP_SCORE(X) >= 45) THEN
    IS_PASSING = 1
  ELSE
    IS_PASSING = 0
  END IF
  IS_PASSING = IS_PASSING
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION SCORE_CLASS(X)
  IF (CLAMP_SCORE(X) < 20) THEN
    SCORE_CLASS = 0
  ELSE
    SCORE_CLASS = 1
  END IF
  IF (IS_PASSING(X) = 1) THEN
    SCORE_CLASS = 2
  END IF
  IF (CLAMP_SCORE(X) = 50) THEN
    SCORE_CLASS = 3
  END IF
  SCORE_CLASS = SCORE_CLASS
END FUNCTION
